title: Evidence before decisions
caption: Synthetic credit analysis. Guided roles. No real credit authorization.

title: 01  Understand the analysis
caption: 150,000 / 100,000 = DSCR 1.5000. Policy outcome and human review stay separate.

title: 02  Follow the evidence
caption: Each verified amount links to a retained source and an exact row/column locator.

title: 03  Record a reasoned assessment
caption: A different simulated actor requests more information. The reason is retained verbatim.

title: 04  Trace and export
caption: The event chain retains the review. PDF/JSON exports preserve the verified snapshot.

title: How the system works
caption: Models propose; code validates and calculates. A separate human endpoint records review.

title: Measured scope
caption: Small mock cohort. No production reliability or model-superiority claim.
